Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 93 (NTT Data Quincy, further attempt): no dedicated page or area overview page found, and reverse geocoding failed on four attempts (one proxy rate limit, three service throttles) with no usable result. research_status upgraded from exhausted to complete, no address applied.

[process narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This facility is attributed in the registry to NTT, part of Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corporation, one of the largest telecommunications and IT services groups in the world, headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. NTT operates a global data center business, NTT Global Data Centers, under NTT DATA, Inc. The operators own about us page, fetched this session, states NTT DATA is a top 10 global IT services provider with about 30 billion dollars in annual revenue, operations across 33 countries, and about 3 billion dollars in annual research and development investment, headquartered at the Toyosu Center Building, 3-3-3 Toyosu, Koto-ku, Tokyo 135-6033, Japan, though these figures describe the wider NTT DATA organization rather than the data center division specifically, and no data center division formation or acquisition date was found on the pages fetched this session. A previously confirmed, specific data center acquisition remains NTT Communications purchase of an 86.7 percent stake in e-shelter, described as Germany top data center operator, completed around June 23, 2015, though that acquisition is not directly connected to this United States facility. This session reached the operators own services.global.ntt data center locations pages directly and successfully. An earlier sessions attempts to reach the ragingwire.com domain had failed and found no corresponding Wikipedia article, a negative finding this session did not need to repeat. No dedicated operator facility page or Washington state or Quincy area overview page was found this session under the URL naming patterns that worked elsewhere for this operator. Reverse geocoding this rows own stored coordinates through a third party service was attempted repeatedly this session, including one attempt rejected by the fetch proxy itself as rate limited and three further attempts throttled by the geocoding service, and never returned usable data. No address is applied.
